name: Agile Leadership Conference 2026
description: online iX/dpunkt conference on leadership in agile teams and AI-driven change
price: 449 EUR + VAT (early bird until 10 Nov; one day 249 EUR)
note: German; online; early bird until 10 Nov; workshops 23 + 30 Nov, 3 Dec
details:
Online conference by dpunkt.verlag and iX (heise), with it-agile and selbstfuehren.de, on leadership at all levels - from self-leadership to agile teams and senior management - in times of crises, transformations and AI. Day 1 (1 Dec) is about people and relationships, day 2 (2 Dec) about structures and processes; mornings have 40-minute talks and short impulses, afternoons two 90-minute deep dives of your choice.

Keynotes: "Kopf, Herz, Hand: Wie Führung im KI-Wandel handlungsfähig bleibt" (Isabell Guhr, Doreen Eisenberg-Timm) and "Überleben in Krisenzeiten" (Jürgen Hoffmann). A free evening event on 1 Dec marks 25 years of the Agile Manifesto (Henning Wolf, Stefan Roock), included in every ticket.

Prices from the heise announcement: 449 EUR for both days (early bird until 10 Nov), 249 EUR for one day, plus VAT; workshops 399 EUR (half day, 23 and 30 Nov) and 549 EUR (full day, 3 Dec); group discount from three people. The official ticket page shows no prices. Sessions are in German. Outside the core stack (leadership, not engineering).
